identity.fantasy: A frost-and-ale warleader who fights beside an Honored Ancestor and turns kegs, cries, totems, and clan rituals into party-wide offense.
identity.one_line: A frost-and-ale warleader who fights beside an Honored Ancestor and turns kegs, cries, totems, and clan rituals into party-wide offense. The defining decision is contextual: Pet behavior and group timing force frequent situational choices.

mechanics.core_loop: A frost-and-ale warleader with a summoned Honored Ancestor, Tankard Fill Level, Keg Smash, and a large collection of raid buffs. War Cry, Tavern Brawl, Clanlord's Totem, Ramhorn Rage, and Warband make it one of the clearest offensive-support trees; the cost is many situational buttons and buff-window management.

modes.name: Cheers!
modes.structural_description: Designate an ally as your drinking partner for 30 minutes, reducing all damage they take by -5%, and causing 10% of all damage they take to be redirected to you.You can only have 1 ally designated at a time.

modes.name: To The Bone
modes.structural_description: Damage dealt by Breath of the North now reduces enemies' resistances by 75 and increases their Magic damage taken by -2% for 8 seconds.

modes.name: The Spins
modes.structural_description: Casting Keg Smash now causes your Honored Ancestor to perform an Ancestral Whirl attack upon nearby enemies.

modes.name: Might of Utgarde
modes.structural_description: Attacks from your Ancestral Combat now heal your Honored Ancestor for 5% maximum health and cause it to perform an Ancestral Whirl attack.

mechanics.single_target: Fight alongside the permanent Honored Ancestor, use the net to amplify Keg Toss, and time War Cry, totems, and Warband for group windows. Current sources describe interactions but do not provide a verified single-target priority.
mechanics.aoe: The ancestor copies Whirlwind and Whirling Charge, giving the pet direct pack participation; Keg and support effects add coverage. Players disagree whether that output compensates for pet-control friction and lower personal damage.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Primarily melee, with the ancestor and support effects preserving some value during movement.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Crystal Enhancements, Icebound Ancestry, Thane's Guard, To The Bone, Ramhorn Rage.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Breath of The North, Frozen Blades, Ancestral Wisdom, Ancestral Fury, Frozen Tankard.

failure_modes.text: Poor pet positioning or control, an unused net-to-Keg interaction, or mistimed group buffs can waste both personal and party value.
An ancestor left on the wrong target cannot copy the Whirls or support the Keg sequence where it matters.
Using War Cry, totems, or Warband outside a party damage window loses group value that personal attacks cannot replace.
